cohort: 163 pregnant women with complete placenta previa and a history of cesarean section who underwent MRI for suspected PAS.
finding: Placental volume was significantly greater in the PAS group compared to the non-PAS group, and a placental volume threshold of more than 887 cm3 demonstrated high sensitivity (85.531%) and specificity (83.907%) for identifying PAS.
cross-section timing: Pre-operative MRI and perinatal outcomes at delivery.
